proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A B C H hABC hA hH hperp
  have core : ∃ x : ℝ, H = AffineMap.lineMap B C x ∧ dist A H ^ 2 = x * (1 - x) * dist B C ^ 2 ∧
      dist A B ^ 2 = x * dist B C ^ 2 ∧ dist A C ^ 2 = (1 - x) * dist B C ^ 2 ∧
      dist B H = |x| * dist B C ∧ dist H C = |1 - x| * dist B C := by
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := mem_affineSpan_pair_iff_exists_lineMap_eq.mp hH
    refine ⟨x, rfl, ?_⟩
    have hdBC : dist B C = ‖C -ᵥ B‖ := by rw [dist_comm, dist_eq_norm_vsub V C B]
    rw [hdBC]
    set d : V := C -ᵥ B with hd
    set h : V := A -ᵥ AffineMap.lineMap B C x with hh
    have hBH : B -ᵥ AffineMap.lineMap B C x = (-x) • d := by
      rw [AffineMap.lineMap_apply, vsub_vadd_eq_vsub_sub, vsub_self, zero_sub, neg_smul]
    have hCH : C -ᵥ AffineMap.lineMap B C x = (1 - x) • d := by
      rw [AffineMap.lineMap_apply, vsub_vadd_eq_vsub_sub, ← hd, sub_smul, one_smul]
    have hin : inner ℝ (B -ᵥ A) (C -ᵥ A) = 0 := by
      rw [InnerProductGeometry.inner_eq_zero_iff_angle_eq_pi_div_two]; exact hA
    have e1 : B -ᵥ A = (-x) • d - h := by rw [← hBH, hh, vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right]
    have e2 : C -ᵥ A = (1 - x) • d - h := by rw [← hCH, hh, vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right]
    have hdh : inner ℝ d h = 0 := by rw [real_inner_comm]; exact hperp
    rw [e1, e2] at hin
    simp only [inner_sub_left, inner_sub_right, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right, hperp, hdh,
      real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq] at hin
    have key : ‖h‖ ^ 2 = x * (1 - x) * ‖d‖ ^ 2 := by linear_combination hin
    have a1 : dist A B ^ 2 = x * ‖d‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [dist_comm, dist_eq_norm_vsub V B A, e1, norm_sub_sq_real, real_inner_smul_left, hdh, norm_smul, key,
        Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_pow, sq_abs]
      ring
    have a2 : dist A C ^ 2 = (1 - x) * ‖d‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [dist_comm, dist_eq_norm_vsub V C A, e2, norm_sub_sq_real, real_inner_smul_left, hdh, norm_smul, key,
        Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_pow, sq_abs]
      ring
    refine ⟨?_, a1, a2, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [dist_eq_norm_vsub V A, ← hh, key]
    · rw [dist_eq_norm_vsub V B, hBH, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_neg]
    · rw [dist_comm, dist_eq_norm_vsub V C, hCH, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  obtain ⟨x, -, h0, h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := core
  have pa : 0 < dist B C := dist_pos.mpr (ne₂₃_of_not_collinear hABC)
  have pc : 0 < dist A B := dist_pos.mpr (ne₁₂_of_not_collinear hABC)
  have pb : 0 < dist A C := dist_pos.mpr (ne₁₃_of_not_collinear hABC)
  have hp : 0 < dist B C ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hx : 0 < x := by
    by_contra hn
    nlinarith [pow_pos pc 2, not_lt.mp hn]
  have hx1 : 0 < 1 - x := by
    by_contra hn
    nlinarith [pow_pos pb 2, not_lt.mp hn]
  rw [abs_of_pos hx] at h3
  rw [abs_of_pos hx1] at h4
  have hprod : dist A H * dist B C = dist A B * dist A C := by
    refine (sq_eq_sq₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)).mp ?_
    rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, h0, h1, h2]
    ring
  constructor
  · refine similar_iff_exists_pos_dist_eq.mpr ⟨dist A B / dist B C, by positivity, fun i j => ?_⟩
    have a1 : dist H B = dist A B / dist B C * dist A B := by
      rw [dist_comm, h3]; field_simp; linarith
    have a2 : dist B A = dist A B / dist B C * dist B C := by
      rw [dist_comm]; field_simp
    have a3 : dist A H = dist A B / dist B C * dist C A := by
      rw [dist_comm C A]; field_simp; linarith
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp <;> grind [dist_comm]
  · refine similar_iff_exists_pos_dist_eq.mpr ⟨dist A C / dist B C, by positivity, fun i j => ?_⟩
    have a1 : dist H A = dist A C / dist B C * dist A B := by
      rw [dist_comm]; field_simp; linarith
    have a2 : dist A C = dist A C / dist B C * dist B C := by
      field_simp
    have a3 : dist C H = dist A C / dist B C * dist C A := by
      rw [dist_comm, dist_comm C A, h4]; field_simp; linarith
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp <;> grind [dist_comm]
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (A B C H : P), ¬Collinear ℝ ({A, B, C} : Set P) → EuclideanGeometry.angle B A C = Real.pi / 2 → H ∈ line[ℝ, B, C] → inner ℝ (A -ᵥ H) (C -ᵥ B) = 0 → Similar ![H, B, A] ![A, B, C] ∧ Similar ![H, A, C] ![A, B, C]
